media.title: Ein Lied für Dich (1933) — Illustrierter Film-Kurier, no. 1951
media.description: Cover of Illustrierter Film-Kurier, no. 1951, devoted to Ein Lied für Dich (1933), Joe May’s film with Jan Kiepura and Jenny Jugo and music by Walter Jurmann and Bronisław Kaper. This is a film-program/periodical cover, not a standard theatrical poster.
media.altText: Illustrated Film-Kurier cover for Ein Lied für Dich, showing film-promotion artwork and issue text.
media.rightsNote: Illustrierter Film-Kurier, no. 1951 (Berlin, 1933). Reviewed 2026-07-05: no individual cover designer credited. Anonymous German work, published 1933 → PD ~2003 (§66 UrhG, 70 yrs); underlying photo PD as Lichtbild (50 yrs); reproductions of PD 2-D works stay PD (EU DSM Art. 14). Rights upgraded fair-use → OK (public domain). Assumes no designer later identified; not legal advice. Credit: 'Illustrierter Film-Kurier, no. 1951 (public domain)'.
